item.why: An offer: *Shall I* + base verb: *Shall I take your coat?*

r12-002.gate_key: cond_first | B1.1 | gap | My course begins on Monday. When it ___, I'll have less free time. (start) |

item.q: My course begins on Monday. When it ___, I'll have less free time. (start)
item.why: After *when*, the present simple for the future: *When it starts*, not *When it will start*.
item.why_lv: Aiz *when* nākotnei lieto Present Simple: *When it starts*, nevis *When it will start.*

r12-003.gate_key: modal_verbs | B1.1 | text | Rewrite the sentence about last month. Start with *Last month*: I have to work every Saturday to cover for a sick colleague. |

accepted: Last month I had to work every Saturday to cover for a sick colleague.

item.q: Rewrite the sentence about last month. Start with *Last month*: I have to work every Saturday to cover for a sick colleague.
item.why: *Last month* is the past: *I had to work*. *must* has no past form for obligation.
item.why_lv: *Last month* ir pagātne: *I had to work.* Pienākumam *must* pagātnes formas nav.
answers: Last month I had to work every Saturday to cover for a sick colleague.

r12-004.gate_key: agreement | B1.2 | mcq | Choose the correct option: ___ at the conference gets a name badge and a free lunch. | Every guest

item.q: Choose the correct option: ___ at the conference gets a name badge and a free lunch.
item.why: *every* and *each* + singular noun + singular verb: *Every room has…*, *Each student gets…*.
item.why_lv: Aiz *every* un *each* ir lietvārds vienskaitlī un darbības vārds vienskaitlī: *Every room has*…, *Each student gets*….
